data.title: Full Stack Cloud Engineer
data.description:
Factbird helps manufacturers make sense of live production data and act on it. For years we have helped factories in many countries reduce waste, keep lines running and plan better, from the floor to management. Hundreds of companies rely on us, and our team in Copenhagen and the US works to keep complex things simple.


Our engineering team is growing, and we are hiring several Full Stack Cloud Engineers who are at ease across our whole stack: React in the browser, Rust and Node.js on the server, and a multi-account AWS setup underneath.
data.key_responsibilities:
Your strengths can sit anywhere on the stack. Some of these roles will lean towards the back end: APIs, data pipelines and cloud infrastructure. Others will lean towards the front end our customers use every day. What counts is that you can own a feature from start to finish and help wherever the team needs you. This is not a role for someone who only wants one side.

We want independent engineers who take ownership, help shape the architecture and enjoy helping colleagues grow. 

You will do well here if you are practical, care about tests and clean design, and can explain a trade-off to an engineer and a non-engineer alike.


What you'll do

Building & shipping
  • Work in a Nix-based setup, from local tooling to cross-compiled builds
  • Take features from a rough idea to tested, monitored code in production
  • Build React features and TypeScript services on Node.js and Rust, running on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS and more, depending on the team)
  • Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for what you build


Team & growth
  • Review code and welcome reviews of your own
  • Join sprint planning, story breakdown and demos
  • Design systems and pipelines from scratch, mentor others, write RFCs and help set our technical standards
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
We want engineers who have seen more than one way of working and will question ours, with a practical attitude that turns open questions into a plan.


The ideal background
  • At least three years of work since a relevant Masters degree
  • Hands-on experience on both front end (React or similar) and back end (Rust/Node.js or similar), even if you prefer one side
  • Comfort with AWS or another large cloud provider
  • A record of shipping features on your own, with care for tests, code quality and design
  • Clear communication with engineers and non-engineers, and strong English fluency.
  • Experience designing systems from scratch, mentoring, or driving architecture decisions

We welcome applicants who want to move to Denmark, as long as you already have the legal right to live and work here. We can help with relocation costs for the right candidate.
data.benefits:
Our people come first. Good products are built by teams that are trusted to decide, and we want a workplace where you do great work and still have time for the rest of life.


Here's what you can look forward to:
  • Flexible working hours: You plan your own day. Work should fit around life, not the other way round.
  • Competitive salary: Pay that matches your skills, experience and contribution.
  • Internet reimbursement: We cover your connection wherever you work from.
  • Thoughtful, human onboarding: A step-by-step start with the context, tools and help you need.
  • A career path that grows with you: Twice a year we sit down to plan your development together.
  • Company-wide gatherings & team days: We meet across teams and countries to catch up and celebrate.
  • A global, inclusive culture: Our team comes from many backgrounds, and we make the most of it.


We'd love to hear from you
If this sounds like you, send us your application and tell us how you would help us improve production monitoring at Factbird.

Know someone who would be a great fit? Feel free to pass this on.

Questions? Write to kontakt@example.com


Factbird is an equal opportunity employer. We want everyone here to feel respected and included, and to have the chance to do well.

We hire on the needs of the role and the skills of the person, never on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by European or local law.

Different backgrounds make our teams stronger. All qualified candidates are warmly invited to apply.

data.title: Large Enterprise Account Director
data.description:
Factbird gives factory teams live insight into their operations without the weight of classic industrial systems. Our plug-and-play sensors and cloud platform turn production data into decisions that lift performance on single lines and across global networks.

We are building an enterprise team to win and grow large, complex manufacturers. This is one of its first hires, with a say in how we open, close and grow our biggest accounts.


The opportunity
We are hiring a Large Enterprise Account Director to lead large deals from the first idea to worldwide rollout.

You will lead a small set of named accounts. That means creating opportunities yourself, winning over senior leaders, working through competing priorities, and building an investment case a CFO will sign.

A pilot is only the start. Success is Factbird becoming the standard across dozens or hundreds of sites.
data.key_responsibilities:
Create the opportunity
  • Form a view on each account: where performance is held back, why it matters now, who owns it and how we can help.
  • Build your own pipeline through research, outreach to executives, internal champions and partners, rather than waiting for inbound leads.

Shape the decision
  • Run discovery that tests assumptions and shows the cost of doing nothing.
  • Use MEDDPICC to steer deals: find the Economic Buyer, criteria, process, competition and risks early.

Navigate complexity and resistance
  • Work many threads at once across Operations, IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal and leadership.
  • See where a deal may stall, raise hard issues openly and find a way around them.

Prove enterprise value
  • Own the commercial plan for pilots together with Solutions Consulting and Customer Success.
  • Agree success measures up front and turn results into a business case with a clear route to scale.

Lead the commercial close
  • Lead deals with large buying groups, long cycles, procurement and legal negotiation.
  • Protect value while making signing simple, and report deal risk honestly.

Turn one site into a global programme
  • Treat the first contract as the start: set up sponsorship, governance and an expansion plan from day one.
  • Grow one site into 20, 100 or more across regions.

Raise the standard
  • Help sharpen our account planning, qualification, deal reviews and expansion playbook.
  • Bring strong opinions, invite challenge and improve decisions around you.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
Enterprise deal leadership
  • 7+ years in complex B2B sales, ideally enterprise SaaS or industrial technology
  • Deals you created, closed and grew yourself
  • Experience with £/€500k–£/€1m+ deals or similar complexity
  • Sales cycles of 6–18 months or more with many functions, sites and senior buyers
  • Pilots turned into multi-site rollouts
  • MEDDPICC or a similar method, used in practice

Strategic and commercial capability
  • Credibility with COOs, CFOs, CIOs and senior operations leaders
  • Business cases built on measurable results
  • Sound judgement on pricing, negotiation, procurement and legal terms
  • Forecasts based on evidence and clear next steps

How you operate
  • You challenge constructively and are not afraid to test anyone's thinking.
  • You keep deals moving and find another route when one is blocked.
  • You are confident yet open to coaching.
  • You run each account like a business of its own.

What success looks like

Within your first 12 months, you will have:
  • Clear strategies for each named account
  • Qualified opportunities with executive sponsors
  • Pilots with agreed success criteria and a route to rollout
  • Expansion plans from a first site to a global standard

Who you will work with
You will report to the VP of Sales and lead a Global Enterprise Pod with Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Finance, Legal and regional sales leaders in EMEA and the US.
